mainEntity.name: How much does a drought-tolerant landscape renovation cost in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a drought-tolerant landscape renovation in Los Angeles varies widely based on factors such as yard size, existing conditions, plant selection, hardscaping elements, and the complexity of the design. A basic project might start from $10,000, while a comprehensive redesign with extensive hardscaping and advanced irrigation could exceed $50,000. We provide detailed estimates after an initial consultation and site assessment to ensure transparency and align with your budget and vision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for drought-tolerant landscaping in Los Angeles vary significantly, typically ranging from $10,000 for basic projects to over $50,000 for comprehensive designs.
